title: Move per-sender seq inside ciphertext (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: remove seq from the outer RoutingEnvelope (§5.2.2); carry it only inside the encrypted inner payload. Outer envelope keeps only what relays use: channelToken, epoch, ts hint, expiryHint, access proof, payload. Resolves agora-pozi.20.56.
